question: How many litres of milk are consumed in Delhi daily?
idealClarificationQuestions: Liquid milk + value-added (curd, paneer, butter, ghee equivalent in milk-equivalent)? Provide both.
Greater Delhi NCR (~32M) or just Delhi (~22M)? Use Delhi proper, ~22M.
Sources: Mother Dairy + Amul + DMS + Paras + private dairies + sachet milk + tetra packs? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × per-capita milk consumption × Delhi-specific premium.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per-capita milk consumption: India avg ~440 ml/day; Delhi ~500-550 ml/day (higher income, higher dairy intensity).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus milk-equivalent in value-added (curd, paneer, ghee made by HH or consumed prepared): adds ~30% = 16M LME (litre milk equivalent).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~12 million litres of liquid milk daily; ~16 million LME including all dairy products.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: India avg ~440 ml/day; Delhi ~500-550 ml/day (higher income, higher dairy intensity).
~12 million litres of liquid milk daily; ~16 million LME including all dairy products.
